auth_env_var_specs.name: TRAVELOKA_SESSION_FILE
auth_env_var_specs.description: Path to a private Traveloka-only cookie and request-profile session file. This is a file path, never a raw Cookie header.

auth_description: Observed core guest-session cookie names for generator metadata. The delivered session importer preserves the complete scoped cookie jar and captured operation profiles; these names do not imply other cookies are unnecessary.
